title: $\Hom$-Lie structures on Lie algebras
summary: We give a systematic description of $\Hom$-Lie structures on several classes of Lie algebras and of their relations with transposed Poisson structures. Our starting point is the observation that the left-hand side of the defining identity is an alternating trilinear map; this makes $\mathcal{H}(\LL)$, the set of $\Hom$-Lie structures of $\LL$, a subspace of $\End(\LL)$ and reduces its computation to increasing triples of basis vectors.
